t: These 750 LED compact string Christmas lights deliver bright decorative illumination for festive displays. Ideal for decorating 7 to 8ft Christmas trees, patios, and gardens, this very warm white set works seamlessly indoors and outdoors. Featuring a 18.72m lit length and a 5m green cable, the mains-powered lights easily cover large areas. An integrated timer automatically runs for 6 hours on and 18 hours off. A selection of 8 distinct lighting modes allows patterns to suit any atmospheric design. An IP44 rating ensures reliable, water-resistant performance throughout the festive season.
